title: Design a merge flow after Anthropic's: lanes merge on own green checks, main bisects and reverts, sessions install from a stable branch
why: Batch CI holds every merge behind one run; the owner is open to a radical redesign.
note: R42 part 2 (owner 13:39 CST Nov 11, "i'm pretty open to this radical approach -- A", relayed by the retrospective; plan 7a78c5c). In stage 3 a Plan agent and a refuter design the flow after the post "Redesigning source control at Anthropic" (Oct 13): a lane merges on its own green checks and a review sized by risk; main's CI runs after merge, and a red run bisects and reverts the breaking commit; sessions install from a stable branch that moves only when main is green. The design goes back to the owner before any build. Needs main to finish a CI run first (#2591). Once the design is ruled, it would retire rule git-no-merge-during-batch-ci.
source: owner 2026-11-11 13:39-13:43 CST, relayed by the retrospective session
